svg.title: About
svg.desc: I'm a Software Developer with a degree in Systems Analysis and Development. I turn practical needs into reliable, accessible software, combining full-stack development, REST APIs, databases and applied AI. My experience includes business-focused web tools, secure data workflows and AI-powered features. I approach development from understanding requirements and designing solutions to automated testing, documentation and deployment.
